label: thm:submul-am
title: Amortized tensor-network execution bound for Kronecker powers of multilinear maps
work: Tensor Network Complexity of Multilinear Maps
difficulty_reason: The selected universal construction rewrites an arbitrary tensor-network execution into a Kronecker-power execution while measuring one-socket contractions by tensor volume rather than their original arithmetic cost. Its full author core handles the three socket-dependence cases and expands each one-socket operation into a sequential chain of k contractions with the stated amortized bound. This structural construction and execution-size control exceed ordinary matrix-rank or tensor-product exercises, and are distinct from the paper’s rank lower bound and specialized graph-homomorphism algorithms.
